[Caikeya]
one of the divisions of the Maitrāyaṇīya recension of the Kṛṣṇa Yv. a. mentioned in the Caraṇavyūha. See TD. 1763.
Correct form Aikeya. See Bhagavad Datta, Vaidik Vāṅmay kā Itihās I. p. 150.
